newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Nov kerosene stocks up 5.0 pct yr/yr-MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan Nov kerosene stocks up 5.0 pct yr/yr-MITI.

text.p: Japan's kerosene stockpiles as of the end of November stood at 4.88 million kilolitres (kl), up 5.0 percent from a year earlier but down 1.8 percent from a month earlier, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry said on Wednesday.
Japanese refiners have been keeping oil product stockpiles at low levels in order to cut storage costs.
But they need to build up stocks of kerosene, used for heating, to meet peak winter demand.
Domestic sales of kerosene during the four-month period from November to February account for about 60 percent of the total annual sales in volume.
